description: This file defines API routes for task management in a web application using FastAPI. It includes endpoints to list, create, retrieve, update, delete, and move tasks, with integration for Jira status updates.

classes.name: MoveTaskPayload
classes.description: Data model for moving a task across sprint, board, and status. It includes optional fields for new sprint ID, board ID, and status.

methods.name: list_tasks( board_id: Optional[int] = Query(default=None, description="Filter by board id"), sprint_id: Optional[int] = Query(default=None, description="Filter by sprint id"), status: Optional[TaskStatus] = Query( default=None, description="Filter by status", ), session: Session = Depends(get_session), )
methods.description: Handles GET requests to list tasks with optional filtering by board, sprint, and status.

methods.name: create_task(payload: TaskCreate, session: Session = Depends(get_session))
methods.description: Handles POST requests to create a new task.

methods.name: get_task(task_id: int, session: Session = Depends(get_session))
methods.description: Handles GET requests to retrieve a task by ID.

methods.name: update_task(task_id: int, payload: TaskUpdate, session: Session = Depends(get_session))
methods.description: Handles PUT requests to update an existing task by ID.

methods.name: delete_task(task_id: int, session: Session = Depends(get_session))
methods.description: Handles DELETE requests to remove a task by ID.

methods.name: move_task(task_id: int, payload: MoveTaskPayload, session: Session = Depends(get_session))
methods.description: Handles POST requests to move a task to a new sprint, board, or status, including optional Jira issue transition.

ctags.name: board_id
ctags.pattern: /^    board_id: Optional[int] = Field(default=None, description="New board id")$/

ctags.name: list_tasks
ctags.signature: ( board_id: Optional[int] = Query(default=None, description="Filter by board id"), sprint_id: Optional[int] = Query(default=None, description="Filter by sprint id"), status: Optional[TaskStatus] = Query( default=None, description="Filter by status", ), session: Session = Depends(get_session), )

ctags.name: move_task
ctags.pattern: /^def move_task(task_id: int, payload: MoveTaskPayload, session: Session = Depends(get_session)):$/
ctags.signature: (task_id: int, payload: MoveTaskPayload, session: Session = Depends(get_session))

ctags.name: sprint_id
ctags.pattern: /^    sprint_id: Optional[int] = Field(default=None, description="New sprint id")$/

ctags.pattern: /^def update_task(task_id: int, payload: TaskUpdate, session: Session = Depends(get_session)):$/
ctags.signature: (task_id: int, payload: TaskUpdate, session: Session = Depends(get_session))
